{{Quote|Next, Jasis Temm, former owner and CEO of Hadlress Defense Systems, Ltd., on Hadlress. ''[&hellip;]'' He sold the company two years ago for 4.6 billion credits and now prefers to apply his knowledge in more 'practical' ways.|[[Secretary/Legends|Secretary]] [[Greal]]|<ref name="GG10">{{WEGCite|story=Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
'''Hadlress''' was an astronomical object<ref name="GG10" /> located in the [[Hadlress system/Legends|Hadlress system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jasis Temm]], the owner and [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of the company [[Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited]], was based on Hadlress.<ref name="GG10" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. "[[Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|Buyer's Market]]" establishes that [[Jasis Temm]] sold his company two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the narrative's events, therefore at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> Temm sold his company for 4.6 billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and eventually became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hadlress was introduced in "[[Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|Buyer's Market]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hadlress [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial object Hadlress, in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA" />
